title: inbox\settings.json schema 4: schema 3 with the hard VM lifetime cap (owner decision Q4) under a new name
x-owner: P12 (supervisor reader and both contract docs); P20 (tray writer); P09.x (the cap rule, allocator.md); schema 3 stays readable

linux_backend.description: Supervisor-side; the tray writes back what status.v5.json reports and never changes it. Flipped only by the cutover item P27. Default wsl-legacy.

vm_lifetime_cap_hours.description: The hard VM lifetime cap (allocator.md, Hard VM lifetime cap): no hyperv-vm reservation lives longer than this many hours from its acquired_at, whatever the job, the guest or GitHub says. A ceiling of 6 hours, default 6: lower is allowed, higher is refused whole and never clamped. It replaces schema 3's lease_wall_clock_hours, which only flagged.

runner_count.description: The Linux count, as in schema 2 (now 0 allowed when Windows >= 1).

job_cpus.description: Legacy WSL pool total, unchanged meaning; the supervisor caps it to the Linux share (shares win); ignored while runner_count is 0 or linux_backend is hyperv-vm.
